messages:
mike: hey all, first week onboarding question. started the `billing` pipeline and the checkout step immediately 403s: "fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood/billing.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403". i accepted the org invite last night. any tips?

laura: welcome Mike :wave: usual suspects: missing SSH key, SSO not linked, or the org GH App (ci-runner) isn't installed for that repo. can you paste the checkout snippet?

mike: clipped log -> fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
remote: Repository not found.

ev an: two quick checks: 1) add your SSH pubkey to github settings 2) check team membership - we gate repo access for CI via the `dev-ci` team so the GH App covers private repos. i'll look up your membership.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `billing/push` #3 failed on job `checkout` 1exit code 128

mike: my local remote is SSH, but buildkite shows https in the logs. i haven't added an SSH key to my account yet.

laura: ok invited you to `dev-ci` and asked infra to re-request GH App install on `billing`. also pushed a small pipeline hook change to prefer SSH for private repos.

infra-bot: infra:ticket #2551 created "Add mike to dev-ci & ensure ci runn er app installed on billing" (assignee: laura)

mike: accepted the team invite and added SSH pubkey. re-triggering the pipeline now.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite: pipeline `billing/push` #4 succeeded on job `checkout` 1duration 39s

laura: nice! root cause was missing SSH key + CI app not yet installed for the repo; also pipeline hook fallback to HTTPS. i'll add a short note to onboarding doc: add SSH key, confirm SSO, accept org GH App, and verify your team (`dev-ci`).

mike: thanks everyone, that fixed it. will put a small docs PR describing the steps.
